6
Which statement about an atom or an ion is correct?
A
In an atom, the number of electrons is equal to the atomic number.
B
In an atom, the number of neutrons is equal to the atomic number.
In a sodium ion, Na+, the number of electrons is greater than the atomic number.
C
D
An atom of hydrogen that contains one neutron has an atomic number of two.
